Routes of Rawalpindi Integrated Transport System - Phase I (table image)

notes: 6 planned feeder routes, 52 km, 78 mini-buses (page listed under 'Upcoming Services', undated, c.2018-19).

routes.name: Suwan Adda - Railway Station

sources.title: PMA, Rawalpindi Integrated Transportation System - Phase I, route table (image)

routes.notes: PMA Phase-I feeder plan for the Rawalpindi-Islamabad Metrobus: route 1, 9 km, 12 mini-buses (8 m). Alignment as printed in the table image: "Suwan Adda to Railway Station via GT Road, Flashman, Haider Rd, Railway Station". Stops = named via-points only (road names left out); spellings normalised (Kashmirian, Pirwadhai, Chandni, Khanna). 'Marrir Br' / 'Murir Bridge' = the bridge at Marrir Chowk (Murree Road). The PMA page still says the routes are 'expected to become operational in near future'; they were never launched. Rawalpindi now has the Punjab green e-bus (rawalpindi-electric-bus.json); CDA/PMA feeders use other numbering (R-1..R-10 in research/incoming/rawalpindi-feeder.json).
